subject.title: Peralta Community College District Board, Area 5

text: My education and qualifications are: I am Sandra Weese, and I am running for the Peralta Community College District Board of Trustees, Area 5, to keep our colleges strong, accessible, and accountable to the communities they serve. For nearly 30 years, I have lived in Oakland and worked in the labor movement. I recently retired after 20 years as Organizing Director for the California Federation of Teachers, where I worked alongside community college faculty and staff throughout California. I understand the challenges facing our colleges, and how collaboration, responsible leadership, and strong advocacy can deliver results. Previously, I organized workers and built community coalitions with SEIU and the Culinary Workers Union. Peralta is at a critical moment. I will work to increase enrollment, stabilize district finances, and protect student access during any proposed merger or restructuring. I will fight to recruit and retain excellent faculty and staff, ensure fair compensation, and preserve the instruction, counseling, and services students need to succeed. I will bring a practical, collaborative voice to the Board. A voice that values students, respects workers, protects undocumented students, opposes unnecessary outsourcing, and demands transparency and public accountability. Together, we can build a stronger, more stable Peralta for everyone. Visit sandra4pccd.nationbuilder.com

statement.disclaimer: Statements have been printed as submitted by the candidates, including any typographical, spelling, or grammatical errors. The statements have not been checked for accuracy by the Registrar of Voters’ office.
